steps.name: Identify & Extract Red Box
steps.description: Locate and extract the Red specimen container from the main containment box.

steps.name: Inspect / Open Red Specimen Box
steps.description: Open and visually verify the sample inside the Red specimen container.

steps.name: Identify & Extract Yellow Box
steps.description: Retrieve the secondary Yellow reagent/tool box from the main containment box.

steps.name: Perform Sample Interaction / Payload Slot Insert
steps.description: Perform reagent transfer, sensor coupling, or slot insertion with both containers active.

steps.name: Return Red & Yellow Boxes to Containment
steps.description: Place both Red and Yellow containers back into their designated compartments in the main box.

steps.name: Close & Latch Main Containment Box
steps.description: Close the lid of the main containment box and lock the safety latches securely.
